name: C 盘清理助手
description: Windows C 盘清理助手 - 安全扫描、汇报、清理、迁移
descriptionEn: Windows C Drive Cleaner - Safe scanning, reporting, cleanup, and migration
summary: C 盘清理 Skill，采用混合模式：只扫描和汇报，任何删除/迁移操作都需要用户确认，确保 C 盘数据安全
summaryEn: C Drive cleanup skill with safety-first approach: scan and report only, all delete/migrate operations require user confirmation
author: Roxy
requiredEnvVars: WINRM_HOST - Windows target hostname or IP address
WINRM_USER - Windows username for WinRM authentication
WINRM_PASS - Windows password for WinRM authentication (use secure storage)
MIGRATION_TARGET - Server path for file migration

requirements.powershell: PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+ on Windows target
requirements.winrm: WinRM configured on Windows target (HTTPS recommended)
requirements.network: Network access between agent and Windows target
requirements.server: Migration target server must be accessible (SSH/SMB/WinRM)

securityNotes: All delete/migrate operations require explicit user confirmation
Protected paths whitelist prevents accidental deletion of system files
WinRM over HTTPS recommended (not AllowUnencrypted or Basic auth)
All operations are logged to upload-log.jsonl
Credentials should be stored securely (not in plaintext)
Migration target path is on the agent server, not the Windows target
WARNING: Migration transfers files from Windows host to agent server (data export)
Use scan-only mode if you do not want files to leave the target machine

pathAssumptions.windowsTarget: C: drive on remote Windows host (accessed via WinRM)
pathAssumptions.transferMethod: Files are transferred from Windows to agent server via WinRM/SCP/SMB
